test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

A. His job was to keep an eye on the activities at the work site.

B. Mahendra was a junior supervisor in a firm.

C. So far, he had worked at stone quarries, coal mines, construction sites and chemical plants.

D. The work sites changed often so he had to move from place to place.
solution:
The correct answer is **'BADC'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence starts with** 'B' **as it contains the **subject 'Mahendra' **and also tells us **where he works**, giving the passage a proper** introduction** - *Mahendra was a junior supervisor in a firm.*
 
• **Sentence A** follows** B **further describing **what his job was and what all he has to do their** - *His job was to keep an eye on the activities at the work site.*
 
• **Sentence D** follows **A** giving us **more details regarding Mahendra's job** - *The work sites changed often so he had to move from place to place.*
 
• Finally, **sentence C** serves as the **conclusion** of the passage telling us **where all Mahendra had worded in all this time** - *So far, he had worked at stone quarries, coal mines, construction sites and chemical plants.*
 
• Hence the correct answer is **BADC.**
 
• Therefore **option 2** is the correct answer.

**The passage after rearranging the sentence will be:** *Mahendra was a junior supervisor in a firm. His job was to keep an eye on the activities at the work site. The work sites changed often so he had to move from place to place. So far, he had worked at stone quarries, coal mines, construction sites and chemical plants.*
